name: Ryū ga Gotoku Ishin! / Like a Dragon: Ishin!

locations.note: Ryōma comes home to Tosa from sword training in Edo, and returns at the end with the Shinsengumi to storm Takechi's stronghold.
Ryōma's adoptive father Yoshida Tōyō is cut down at the castle by a masked assassin; Ryōma later duels Takechi in the same room.
As Saitō Hajime, Ryōma joins the Shinsengumi at Mibu and hunts his father's killer through Kyo, from the Teradaya inn in Fushimi to the Ikedaya raid.
Gion is the red-light district of the game's 1860s Kyo, where Ryoma drinks and gambles between Shinsengumi duties.
Ryōma and Okita storm the castle to hand Shogun Tokugawa Yoshinobu the terms of the Great Restoration.

routes.name: Ryōma's road
routes.note: From Tōyō's murder at Kōchi Castle to the Shinsengumi in Kyo, a ride to Edo Castle and back to Tosa for the reckoning with Takechi.
